name: gizmo
description: Open-source toolkit for browser 3D worlds, local automation, and MCP-compatible agent workflows.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=engine && npm run build --workspace=mcp && npm run build --workspace=cli
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=engine && npm run test --workspace=mcp && npm run test --workspace=cli
scripts.validate: npm run docs:check && npm run skills:check && npm run validate --workspace=cli
scripts.build:package: npm run build:package --workspace=engine && npm run build --workspace=mcp && npm run build --workspace=cli
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm pack --dry-run --workspace=engine && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=mcp && npm run build --workspace=cli && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=cli
